title: Layanan nasabah TERBURUK
text:
Linkaja merupakan aplikasi fintech dengan layanan nasabah terburuk. 
Pelayanan nasabah hanya melalui bot dan tidak terhubung dengan agen expert. 

Tidak ada kontak center maupun email yg bisa dihubungi untuk menyampaikan keluhan maupun kendala. 

Jadi berhati2 bertransaksi di linkaja, sekali mengalami trouble, anda tidak dapat mengadu kemana2. 

Mohon layanan nasabah dapat diperbaiki dulu.

title: Bad Customer Support
text:
I have been using the LinkAja app for a while now, and while the app itself is decent, the customer support is extremely disappointing. I encountered an issue with a transaction and reached out to their customer support team. To my surprise, it took them several days to respond, and even then, the response was generic and unhelpful.

It’s frustrating to wait so long for assistance, especially when dealing with financial transactions. Customer support is a crucial aspect of any service, and LinkAja’s slow response times are unacceptable. I hope they improve their support system soon because this experience has seriously made me consider switching to a different app.
